author: Cezbla
body:
Hello, I have been talking to paraspider and he said that walls YML are really hard.  Ivycode can do them, I am now really trying to learn this so it can be 2 people instead of one. Ivycode I know this is asking a  lot but can you teach me how to do this. I am extremely  interested and I think it could even help the server and take a bit off your back,. So instead of worrying about one more thing I can help or teach other people to help.


IvyCode, If we can do this it would be great I would love to help as well as love to learn this, I have set a new goal so if you see this may you please consider this, thank you.


I understand if you don't want to teach me but I only know you that can do this.


Best regards, Cezbla
